rationale: Vellum move P18 (follow-up to F3b, Pulp #10077). Adds an end-to-end test, registered as import-design-external-asset-localized, proving pulp-import-design copies a local asset named outside the source design's directory into the saved document's assets/<sha256>.png: the file is recorded by that relative path, its bytes hash to the recorded content_hash, and with the external source deleted pulp-design-ir-observe still paints it from the saved document under the loader's document-root containment. A missing external file still reports asset-unresolved. The only source edits are comments: core/view/include/pulp/view/design_ir_io.hpp (doc comment on collect_design_ir_assets) and core/view/src/design_import.cpp (comment in resolve_local_asset) state that an external file keeps an absolute path there and that a caller serializing the IR must copy it beside the document first. They also correct a stale claim that a hash-gated recovery path remains for external files, which #10077 removed. Those two paths select design-ir-contract and render-assets-and-backends; the new test file and its manifest line select design-source-ingest. No behaviour, importer output, DesignIR schema, renderer, asset, packaging or Vellum artifact changes, and no authority moves.
